text:
For an iPhone 17, the slimmest packs hold 5,000 mAh. The slimmest 10,000 mAh packs run about 0.5″ thick and add 25 W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which the iPhone 17 supports. Here's how they compare in the search results:

## Best ultra-slim (5K): Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)
- **0.34″ thick, 122 g**, Qi2-certified **15 W** wireless, 20 W USB-C both ways
- Anker markets it for the iPhone 17 series. 9to5Mac's reviewer, after extended use, called it the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery and said it runs cooler than competitors.
- About a full charge's worth at most: 5K packs typically give 60–75% of a charge, per Macworld.
- **$54.99, $5 off with an auto-applied code**
- **Buy:** https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank
- Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

## Best slim 10K with full 25 W speed: INIU SnapGo Air (Qi2.2)
- **0.5″ thick, 195 g**, **25 W** Qi2.2 wireless, 45 W wired, includes a 60 W lanyard-style USB-C cable, LED display
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack. Android Central tested it and highlighted its value.
- **About $42.99 at Amazon / $44.99 at INIU.** The search results didn't include a direct store URL, so use the buy buttons in [Android Central's review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

## Other good options
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K**: also tied for slimmest 10K, 25 W wireless / 45 W wired, built-in cable. It got the **best capacity score in Macworld's recharge test**. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html))
- **Kuxiu S4 10K**: tied for slimmest, 25 W, semi-solid-state battery, kickstand, display. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html))
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe 5K**: 0.35″, 119 g, 15 W, semi-solid-state battery, about $49.99. ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 10K**: 25 W Qi2.2, 45 W wired. $59.99 at Baseus, or **$53.99 with code AM52** (a deal site verified the code on 10/24). The listing doesn't give its thickness, so I can't confirm it's slim. Its returns window is only 7 days. [Buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) (an affiliate link from that deal site).

## Skip if speed matters
- **Baseus PicoGo Air AM71**: the thinnest of all at 0.27″ and 104 g, but only 7.5 W wireless.
- **Apple MagSafe Battery** ($99): built for the iPhone Air and limited to 12 W. ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/))

**My pick:** Get the **Anker Nano 5K** if you want something that disappears in your pocket. Get the **INIU SnapGo Air** if you want about twice the capacity and 25 W speed for less money.

Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
